[[Fable Reef]] |Time = Any time |Season = {{Season|All}} |Weather = Any weather |Difficulty = 110 |Behavior = Dart |Size = 200 - 250 in |XP = 39 |Edibility = 35 |base = 800 |Roe = yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of [[Fish]] that can be caught in ocean locations in [[Fable Reef]] and [[Stardew:Ginger Island|Ginger Island]] during any season, at any time, in any weather. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {{PAGENAME}} can be caught in any eligible ocean location. {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Fable Reef.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || [[File:Fish Zone Island West.png|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Fable Reef - Fishing Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, west - Fishing Zones |} {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Island South.png|400px|class=responsive-image]] || [[File:Fish Zone Island Southeast.png|500px|class=responsive image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, south - Fishing Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Ginger Island, southeast - Fishing Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love=Willy |neutral=Demetrius, Elliott, Leo, Linus, Pam, Sebastian |hate=Evelyn, Haley, Pierre }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Shark}} ==Recipes== {{PAGENAME}} is not specifically used in any artisan, cooking, or crafting recipes. ==Bundles== When '''"SVE Bundles"''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} is required to complete the {{Bundle|missing|32|y}}. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|white}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a white color. ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced
